title: CNC turning & milling of housing
description: CNC turning & milling of housing capability for titanium components
thicknessRange: Up to 400 mm diameter x 1000 mm length
processDescription: CNC turning of titanium on multi-axis lathes produces cylindrical components with precision diameters and surface finishes. Live tooling enables milling and drilling in the same setup, specifically for housing. Precision housing for Aerospace, Marine present unique challenges: Thin-wall cylindrical sections (1.5–4 mm) with multiple mounting bosses require stress-relieved cast/wrought stock and sequenced roughing to prevent distortion.
heatControl: High-pressure coolant-through-tool for chip breaking and heat evacuation.
flatnessControl: Steady rests for long slender parts. Stress-relieved stock recommended.
capabilitiesDescription: Precision machining capability for CNC turning & milling of housing, utilizing multi-axis CNC centers with in-process inspection and SPC quality control.
